# Views

A view is generated from the definition and never edited. `pds view NAME [ID]` prints one; `pds views` writes them all.

| View | Title | Answers | Pointed at | Form | Reads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product-map` | Product map | What is in the product, at every zoom level, and how complete is each part? | product or any domain, capability or feature | outline + mermaid | the elements |
| `card` | Element card | Everything about one element on one page: what it says, where it sits, what connects to it, what is missing. | any element | bundle | `anchor` |
| `spec` | Feature specification | What is the complete specification of this feature, assembled from its parts? | a feature (or a capability) | bundle | `governed_by`, `requires`, `gated_by`, `audience`, `serves`, `accesses`, `emits` |
| `flow` | Flow diagram | How does this flow run: who does what, where it branches, how it ends? | a flow | mermaid | `touches`, `audience` |
| `state` | State diagram | Which states can this be in, and what moves it between them? | a state machine | mermaid | `lifecycle_of` |
| `er` | Entity relationships | What information does the product keep, and how does it relate? | product or a domain | mermaid | `associates` |
| `context` | System context | Who and what does the product exchange things with, from the outside? | product | mermaid | `integrates_with`, `depends_on`, `audience` |
| `journey` | Journey map | What does a person go through, stage by stage, and where does it hurt? | a journey | mermaid + table | `spans`, `touches` |
| `screens` | Screen map | Which screens exist and how does a person move between them? | product or a feature | mermaid | `navigates_to`, `touches`, `on_surface` |
| `touchpoints` | Touchpoint inventory | Where does the product meet a person or a system, which flows use each place, and who is there? | product | table | `touches`, `audience`, `on_surface` |
| `permissions` | Permission matrix | Which role can do what, and which feature needs which permission? | product | table | `grants`, `holds`, `requires` |
| `crud` | CRUD matrix | Which feature or flow creates, reads, updates or deletes which entity? | product or a domain | table | `accesses` |
| `entitlements` | Entitlement matrix | What does each plan include, and what does each entitlement gate? | product | table | `grants`, `gated_by` |
| `trace` | Traceability | From each objective down to the capabilities, features, requirements and tests that carry it, and back up. | product or any element | table | `serves`, `derives_from`, `satisfies`, `verifies`, `measured_by`, `evidenced_by` |
| `registers` | Registers | What is still open: questions, assumptions, risks and decisions, and what do they concern? | product or any element | table | `concerns`, `resolved_by` |
| `glossary` | Glossary | What does each word mean, and which words must not be used? | product or a domain | table | the elements |
| `coverage` | Coverage report | How complete is the definition, by family, by tier and by element type, and what is the next best thing to write? | product | bundle | the elements |
| `deps` | Dependency graph | What depends on what, and what would a change to this reach? | product or a domain | mermaid | `depends_on`, `supersedes` |
| `release` | Release scope | What is in this release, and how ready is each part? | a release | table | `includes` |
| `obligations` | Obligation map | Which duties apply, what meets each, and what proves it? | product | table | `satisfies`, `verifies` |
| `events` | Event catalogue | Which events exist, who emits them, who reacts, and which metric counts them? | product | table | `emits`, `consumes`, `sourced_from` |
